title: Symmetric H-plane T-junction of WR-90, arms 20 mm, ports across x, x and y: S-parameters against field superposition
source: Field superposition in the junction square, three expansions (one per open side) matched to the TE modes of the three guides (A. Sieverding, F. Arndt, IEEE Trans. MTT 40(2):353–362, 1992; J. Uher, J. Bornemann, U. Rosenberg, Waveguide Components for Antenna Feed Systems, Artech House 1993), emcraft-theory's `tee::h_plane` with 1500 modes per side (converged to about 1e-5), moved to the ports 20 mm out by e^{−jβ(l_i + l_j)}, l = 20 mm: `cargo run --release -p emcraft-theory --example tee_reference -- h 1500 20 8.5 10.5 12`

quantities.reason: second-order elements adapted at 10.5 GHz from 3 mm: the field's r^{2/3} singularities at the two re-entrant corners are refined towards (4e-4 to 6.4e-4 measured; a uniform 2 mm mesh errs by 1e-3 to 2e-3)
measured within 0.29°: a complex error of 1.2e-3 on |S11| = 0.21 is 0.33°
the straight-through wave, little disturbed by the junction's corners (2e-4 measured)
the side arm takes the field past both re-entrant corners (1.1e-3 measured at 12 GHz, 1e-4 to 2e-4 below)
measured within 0.16°

quantities.quantity: phase of S32 (degrees): S32 = S31 at 8.5 GHz
quantities.reason: symmetric: S32 = S31 but for the mesh's asymmetry (0.01° measured), so it errs as S31's phase does
seen from the side arm (7.5e-4 measured)
